name: nba-cup
title: NBA Cup
description: An NBA Cup card for json-render chats: one group's table this season, its five teams in order with logos, games played, wins, losses, points for and against, and point difference, on Fluid Functionalism's Table, with its API route in front of the NBA's public stats API.
docs:
Turn the card on in the chat (one line in each file, see the comments in them):

  features/chat/chat-catalog.ts:   NbaCupCard: nbaCupCatalogEntry
  features/chat/chat-registry.tsx: NbaCupCard: ({ props, loading }) => <LiveNbaCupCard group={props.group || undefined} streaming={loading} />
  features/chat/chat-steps.ts:     NbaCupCard: nbaCupLookup

Group tables load from /api/nba-cup (installed at app/api/nba-cup/route.ts), backed by the NBA's public stats API. No API key needed.
